5.0 from 29 Google reviews (aggregated listing)
Hours Mon-Fri 7am-9pm, weekends by appointment

website_review.primary_cta: Start now (to Calendly) / CONSULTATION page
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Calendly link exists (calendly.com/elevateptr) but is hard-coded to ?month=2020-10; the CONSULTATION page has no form or booking at all
website_review.trust_signals: Named therapist biography, patient testimonials, 5.0 Google rating elsewhere, real photos of work in a gym setting

top_opportunities.opportunity: AI agent that screens consult requests (insurance vs cash, injury type, location) and books into open Calendly slots
top_opportunities.evidence: Solo practitioner advertising free consults and email/phone-only contact

listing.reviews: No reviews listed

size_signals.signal: In-house optical lab that edges and finishes lenses on site for many same-day orders
Doctor plus named staff (Dr. Silvana Abadeer OD and her team), one East Brunswick location at 545 NJ-18
Deep site: separate pages for 20+ conditions and services, a blog, insurance and 'concierge care' pages

website_review.primary_cta: 'BOOK NOW' (hero button) opening the ADIT booking portal in a new tab, plus a header 'Call or Text' number
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Yes - booking.adit.com portal with 'This Appointment is for' (Myself/Spouse/Child) and new-vs-existing patient steps; no CAPTCHA observed
website_review.trust_signals: Named doctor with photo, patient testimonials, photos of the lobby and practice, insurance page, dry-eye expertise pages, blog
website_review.out_of_date_signs: On a 390 px phone the header block (social icons, address, 'Call or Text' number, Menu) fills roughly the top half of the screen before the logo, and a Vimeo background video shows burned-in screen text that collides with the headline so the hero reads as broken
website_review.search_basics: Strong: title and meta description name the eye doctor, service and East Brunswick, and conditions/services each have their own page with keyword-rich URLs; Optician JSON-LD is present, robots.txt blocks nothing important and names a sitemap index

Bookable: real online booking through booking.adit.com with patient-type and new/existing steps and no CAPTCHA; there is no on-site form and no quote path.

operations_signals.signal: Booking runs through a third-party portal while the site also advertises 'Call or Text', so intake arrives in at least three channels - inference: staff reconcile them manually
In-house lens edging promises same-day service on many prescriptions - inference: lab order status questions land on the front desk
Site markets high-touch 'concierge care' and dry-eye treatment packages - inference: higher-ticket, consultation-led sales that reward fast follow-up

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add an on-site, agent-submittable contact/quote request form (frame or dry-eye consult, insurance question) alongside the ADIT booking so enquiries do not dead-end at a phone number
top_opportunities.evidence: No form exists on the home page or booking flow; only 'Call or Text' and the external portal

top_opportunities.opportunity: Fix the mobile hero and header: move address/social below the fold, use a clean poster still instead of the video frame, and put BOOK NOW and the phone number in the first screen
top_opportunities.evidence: 390 px screenshot shows the header occupying about half the viewport and video text bleeding through behind the headline

top_opportunities.opportunity: Extend schema beyond Optician: add openingHours, services, geo and price range so an AI agent can answer hours/location/insurance questions from structured data
top_opportunities.evidence: Only an Optician node with name, url, logo, image and description was found - no hours or address fields

scores.reasons: Gap: modest - the site is well structured, ranks for many conditions and books online; problems are presentation and plumbing rather than fundamentals. Pay: luxury eyewear, in-house lab and dry-eye treatment revenue at a Route 18 location, so high ticket values. Ease: form, hero and schema fixes are quick. Evidence: I loaded the pages, opened the ADIT booking flow and took the mobile screenshot myself, but Google listing numbers came from a directory, not Google.

Appointment policy requires calling in advance and warns emergencies may cause delays, so the phone is the single intake channel during a five-day surgical schedule
Only about a dozen Google reviews for a practice with 40+ clinic hours a week - inference: reviews are not being systematically requested

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add online scheduling or at minimum a labelled appointment-request form, plus digital new-patient intake to replace the PDF
top_opportunities.evidence: New Patients page offers only a PDF download and no form exists anywhere; Office page says patients must call in advance

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add Physician/LocalBusiness JSON-LD and surface reviews on-page; the text content is already strong enough for AI agents to quote once it is marked up
top_opportunities.evidence: No script[type=application/ld+json] on any page checked; about 12 reviews despite a schedule running to 7:30pm

top_opportunities.evidence: Office page warns that unforeseen emergencies delay the doctor and asks patients to be flexible - inference: schedule churn

Evidence: I read the pages and checked for schema myself; the 403 and low review count are directly observed, though review counts come from an aggregator.

name: AZNO Foot & Ankle Specialist
what_they_do: Podiatry practice of Dr. Nadia Shah, DPM (New York College of Podiatric Medicine, three-year reconstructive foot and ankle surgical residency at Hoboken University Medical Center), providing primary foot care, condition treatment and surgery for central New Jersey from one East Brunswick office.

website_review.primary_cta: 'BOOK ONLINE' in the nav and multiple 'Request An Appointment Today' buttons, plus an accessibility bar with 'Call Us' and 'Text Us'

top_issues: No LocalBusiness/Physician schema - only generic WebPage/WebSite/ReadAction nodes, so hours and address are not machine-readable

operations_signals.signal: Separate 'Text Us' channel plus a 'what can we improve' feedback page - inference: the practice already runs multi-channel patient messaging with no unified inbox visible
Single provider covering Mon-Fri 8am-7pm plus Saturday mornings with ~1,300 reviews - inference: front-desk triage and rescheduling are the constraint
Contact form still asks patients to avoid sending health information, pushing clinical questions back to the phone

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add full Physician/LocalBusiness schema (address, hours including the Sunday-by-appointment rule, provider, services) so agents can answer 'are you open, where, who, what do you treat' without scraping
top_opportunities.evidence: ld+json on the site contains only WebPage, WebSite, ReadAction, BreadcrumbList and SearchAction types - no LocalBusiness or Physician

top_opportunities.opportunity: Replace the reCAPTCHA-gated contact form with an agent-submittable intake that captures reason for visit and insurance, and route it into the same queue as the Tebra bookings
top_opportunities.evidence: Contact form includes a g-recaptcha-response field and instructs patients not to describe their problem

Pay: high review volume implies a busy, profitable practice that can afford work. Ease: schema plus form changes are days of work. Evidence: I verified schema types, the booking redirect to Tebra, the reCAPTCHA and the mobile cookie overlay myself; review figures come from aggregators.

Phone number and hours exist only inside the lead-gen directories

operations_signals.signal: Every enquiry arrives through a paid lead marketplace rather than an owned channel (inference from the absence of any site)
162 reviews mention punctuality and communication, a volume of client messaging that is likely handled personally by the owner (inference)

top_opportunities.evidence: No owned site found; only HomeAdvisor/Angi profiles carry the details
